gum-tree-arp-tupelo-ms.assessment: ARP congregation in Tupelo, Mississippi Valley Presbytery. Westminster Standards, male-only elders/deacons, Seceder-Erskine Presbyterian heritage.

score_notes.christology: ARP affirms Nicene orthodoxy — Christ fully God and fully man, sole mediator.
score_notes.scripture: Westminster Standards affirmed — Scripture inerrant, infallible, sufficient.
score_notes.gender: Male-only teaching and ruling elders per ARP Form of Government. Male-only clergy.
score_notes.leadership: Plurality of male elders with ARP Synod/presbytery accountability; historic Scots-Irish Presbyterian polity.
score_notes.soteriology: Reformation soteriology — Westminster Confession articulation of sola fide/sola gratia/solus Christus.
score_notes.cultural: Conservative Southern Presbyterian heritage; resistant to progressive theology; historic commitments intact.
score_notes.preaching: Expository preaching from the whole counsel of God; traditional Presbyterian homiletic.
score_notes.mission: Great Commission and covenantal Reformed evangelism; Erskine heritage of missions.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Varies by congregation; historic ARP emphasizes household-led discipleship.
score_notes.denominational: ARP (Associate Reformed Presbyterian) — conservative Southern Presbyterian denomination with Erskine College/Seminary heritage and male-only officers.
